title.zh: 【FOUNDATION：钓鱼邮件事件涉及超 2.3 万次发送尝试，部分历史订单个人信息或遭泄露】
title.en: 【FOUNDATION：钓鱼邮件事件涉及超 2.3 万次发送尝试，部分历史订单个人信息或遭泄露】

current_state.zh: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker FOUNDATION reported that its email systems recorded more than 23,000 phishing attempts and that legacy WooCommerce data tables, refund records, abandoned carts and post-Shopify-migration orders may have leaked customer personal information, while affirming no evidence that Passport devices or stored private keys were affected.
current_state.en: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker FOUNDATION reported that its email systems recorded more than 23,000 phishing attempts and that legacy WooCommerce data tables, refund records, abandoned carts and post-Shopify-migration orders may have leaked customer personal information, while affirming no evidence that Passport devices or stored private keys were affected.
